content:
You belong to the internet or at least an excess of you is handed over. In return, you're given a coat which when on takes up a convex drape. Ok, I imagine you put on the coat, a kind of technical clay to limit your around receptivity. It is blue on the outside and goes together with a yellow inner.

The coat at first goes over your head. You’re a small car through a bored tunnel. The hairs on your arms have nowhere to stand up to cold or a fright. You have a garment sitting on top of you. This entitles an impossible alertness in signal and sense. Yet it’s brief. The clay of the coat itches and vexes. You flop in a loss.

You are soft enough and in a complicated-enough scenario now to meet others, forget their names, dodge their eyes.

parent.content:
BUT WHAT ABOUT THE NATURAL SCIENCES, I would ask. Six weeks later, WE HAVE 4.530 ENTRIES ON THIS IN 190 SUBDIVISIONS, came the reply. I would think about you and the natural sciences. Your response—a mute bond—would be already out-of-date, new entries inhaled through the breath of the telegraph. I would sit on top of my card cabinet fluttering the to date seventeen responses I had received, and kicking my legs.
—I WANT TO KNOCK THE CEILING WITH THE TOP OF MY HEAD, I then sent.
—THAT IS NOT HOW HEADS WORK. THEY ARE TOO COMPACT, in response.

The operator on this end had drawn three question marks, under the message, on the card, in disbelief. The operator on this end had black hair and green eyes. With all who had taken part, I would not know where to focus my attention within the relay or as we may think. ∎
parent.readme: Sitting in a satellite office of the Cite Mundiale, falling in love either with you or that which is just immediately before you.
